data.title: Missoni - Urban Oasis
data.about:
Come home to the Miami lifestyle in Dubai! Only at Urban Oasis by Missoni. These are apartments designed to perfection by Missoni, for the first time in the city. 

These apartments range from studios to 4 BR options with views of the Dubai Canal and the city’s skyline. It is beautifully designed by Missoni and has private elevators for the penthouses. This is 38 floors of the best Miami lifestyle. Come home to the high-end lifestyle only at Urban Oasis.

characteristics_module.title: Miami Lifestyle in the Heart of Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Penthouse waterfront living in Dubai
  • Interiors designed by Missoni, world class designer
  • Studio, 1, 2, 3, 4 starting at AED 606K
  • Pay 60% over 6 years
  • Get 50% waiver on land registration fee
  • Private elevators with luxury homes

location_tile.title: Nestled by the Dubai Canal, Urban Oasis is the place for you if you want fantastic water views.
location_tile.description:
Close to the Burj Khalifa and the major attractions of the city, you can easily access Urban Oasis from Sheikh Zayed Road.

  • 06 mins – Burj Khalifa | Business Bay
  • 08 mins – DIFC
  • 12 mins – Dubai International Airport
  • 16 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 18 mins – Palm Jumeirah

seo.metaTitle: Missoni Urban Oasis: Off-Plan Stylish Apartments
seo.metaDescription: Missoni - Urban Oasis offers studios to 4 BR apartments with Dubai Canal and skyline views, private elevators, and Miami-inspired interiors.
